# [PR #3228] [CUDA] Fix boolean bitwise negation codegen

source: https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang/pull/3228
state: closed | updated: 2026-09-16T04:21:06Z

## 正文

Fixes #2976.
Fixes https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang/issues/2993.
Lower boolean `~` through logical negation to avoid C++ integer promotion, including vector operands.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary

- Fixes CUDA code generation for boolean `~` with logical negation.
- Fixes vectorized integer `~` with lane-wise complement operations.
- Preserves scalar integer and `int8` behavior.
- Adds CUDA regression coverage for boolean and vectorized integer bitwise negation.

## C++ style / lint notes

- The PR does not modify `docs/developer_guide/cpp_style.md`.
- That guide documents the C++ API style audit.
- CI runs the **C++ API Style Audit (warning only)**.
- No lint or test execution results were provided.

<details>
<summary>Full details: Linked Issues check</summary>

**Explanation**

The production change addresses both linked issues. It lowers boolean `builtin::bitwise_not()` through `Not(...)`, which avoids C++ integer promotion and also covers boolean vector operands. It lowers fixed-length signed and unsigned integer vectors through lane-wise XOR with an all-ones mask. `test_boolean_bitwise_not_values` covers boolean results cast to `int32`, and `test_vector_boolean_bitwise_not_compiles` covers a boolean vector. `test_vector_integer_bitwise_not_values` covers only `int32` values. The linked requirement in [`#2993`] requires regression coverage for vectorized 16-, 32-, and 64-bit integer tensors and packed vector operands. The reviewed test changes do not establish that coverage.

**Resolution**

Add CUDA regression tests for vectorized signed and unsigned 16-, 32-, and 64-bit `~` operations. Include packed vector operands, such as `int4`, `short4`, `uint4`, and `longlong2`, and verify results against scalar `~` or the `^ -1` reference. Retain coverage for scalar and `int8` behavior.

</details>
